5_auth_page_layout_fix_guidance.problem: Hero text on the left gets cut off behind the login/register form card at 1440px and 1920px viewports.
5_auth_page_layout_fix_guidance.root_cause: Absolute positioning overlap or missing flex/grid gap calculation on wide screens.

solution_css.container: display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(420px, 480px); gap: 3rem; align-items: center; max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%; min-height: 100vh; padding: 2rem;

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case for robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='terms-section-1').
Never use completely transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, or overlays with content scrolling underneath. Use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque surfaces.
Ensure WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large headers) on all hover, active, and focus states.
